definitions.explanation: An employment arrangement where an employee is temporarily assigned to work at a different company or department while maintaining their original employment relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出向|しゅっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I'll be on secondment to a subsidiary starting next month.

examples.japanese: {出向|しゅっこう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}った→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧。
examples.english: The experience at my secondment company was useful.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出向|しゅっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えて→終える：02019_oeru⟧⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: I returned to headquarters after a three-year secondment.

notes:
TYPES OF SECONDMENT:
- ⟦{在籍|ざいせき}→在籍：21436_zaiseki⟧{出向|しゅっこう} (secondment while remaining on original company's roster)
- ⟦{転籍|てんせき}→転籍：26317_tenseki⟧{出向|しゅっこう} (transfer with change of employer - permanent)

RELATED BUSINESS TERMS:
- {出向|しゅっこう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination company for secondment)
- {出向|しゅっこう}⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (original/sending company)
- {出向|しゅっこう}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ (seconded employee)
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧ (job transfer within the same company)

JAPANESE BUSINESS CONTEXT: {出向|しゅっこう} is a common practice in Japanese companies, often used to:
- Train employees at affiliated companies
- Support struggling subsidiaries
- Develop business relationships between companies
- Manage excess personnel without layoffs
